name: norm_le_of_dvd'
source: private theorem norm_le_of_dvd' {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {x y : ℤ_[l]} (h : x ∣ y) : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
show: If an ℓ-adic integer x divides y, the ℓ-adic norm of y is at most the norm of x.
strategy: Write y as x times an ℓ-adic integer. The second factor has norm at most one.

steps.claim: Write $y=xz$ with $z\in\mathbf Z_\ell$. Since $\lVert z\rVert\le1$ and $\lVert x\rVert\ge0$, multiplicativity gives $\lVert y\rVert=\lVert x\rVert\lVert z\rVert\le\lVert x\rVert$.
steps.snippet:
private theorem norm_le_of_dvd' {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {x y : ℤ_[l]} (h : x ∣ y) : ‖y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ := by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := h
  rw [norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (PadicInt.norm_le_one z)
